parsed.rationale: The cluster pairs `MockStructuredAnalytics.CPUSessionEventProxy__Playback` located in `Shared/Analytics/Sources/AnalyticsTesting/MockStructuredAnalytics.swift` against the production type `CPUSessionEvent` in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Analytics/PlaybackAnalytics.swift`. The path `AnalyticsTesting` and the `Mock` prefix in the type name are canonical indicators of a test/mock fixture. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a mock-marked or mock-named record must be treated as a mock-fixture no-action, because lifting the production `CPUSessionEvent` into shared code to unify it with its mock proxy would couple production semantics to test infrastructure. Additionally, all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_ancestor`, `shared_field_count`) are null, meaning there is no quantitative grounding to support an actionable refactor recommendation.
